back_translation: No readable assessment analysis was chosen. Choose an assessment to include its findings.

english: {n} measures have readable matched answers. Read matched and unmatched counts for each measure; they can differ.
afrikaans_before: {n} maatstawwe het leesbare gepaarde antwoorde. Lees die gepaarde en ongepaarde tellings vir elke maatstaf; dit kan verskil.
back_translation: {n} measures have readable matched answers. Read the matched and unmatched counts for each measure; they may differ.

back_translation: Matched change is not included until compatible before/after assessments have been chosen and are readable.

english: Prepared {today}. Milestone observation cutoff: {date}. Assessment answers and action status are current snapshots from the latest available records.
afrikaans_before: Voorberei {today}. Afsnydatum vir mylpaalwaarnemings: {date}. Assesseringsantwoorde en aksiestatus is huidige momentopnames uit die jongste beskikbare rekords.
back_translation: Prepared {today}. Cutoff date for milestone observations: {date}. Assessment answers and action status are current snapshots from the latest available records.

english: Only published evidence from the authorised funder projection is included. Private comments, staff ratings, participant identities and internal action owners are excluded. Matched comparisons require both assessments to be closed and published.
afrikaans_before: Slegs gepubliseerde bewyse uit die gemagtigde befondserprojeksie word ingesluit. Private opmerkings, personeelgraderings, deelnemeridentiteite en interne aksie-eienaars is uitgesluit. Gepaarde vergelykings vereis dat albei assesserings gesluit en gepubliseer is.
back_translation: Only published evidence from the authorised funder projection is included. Private remarks, staff ratings, participant identities and internal action owners are excluded. Matched comparisons require both assessments to be closed and published.

english: Internal analysis follows the existing organisation permissions. This report omits participant identities and written feedback. Review recorded action owners before external sharing.
afrikaans_before: Interne ontleding volg die bestaande organisasietoestemmings. Hierdie verslag laat deelnemeridentiteite en geskrewe terugvoer weg. Hersien aangetekende aksie-eienaars voordat dit ekstern gedeel word.
back_translation: Internal analysis follows the existing organisation permissions. This report leaves out participant identities and written feedback. Review recorded action owners before sharing externally.

english: Project labels scope each source; they do not prove that a milestone, assessment and portfolio cohort describe the same people or gardens. No automatic join to portfolio totals is made.
afrikaans_before: Projeketikette begrens elke bron; hulle bewys nie dat 'n mylpaal, assessering en portefeuljegroep dieselfde mense of tuine beskryf nie. Geen outomatiese koppeling aan portefeuljetotale word gemaak nie.
back_translation: Project labels limit each source; they do not prove that a milestone, assessment and portfolio group describe the same people or gardens. No automatic linking to portfolio totals is made.

english: Donor filter: {name}, applied only to linked indicator definitions. Assessment scope is unchanged.
afrikaans_before: Skenkerfilter: {name}, slegs toegepas op gekoppelde aanwyserdefinisies. Assesseringsomvang is onveranderd.
back_translation: Donor filter: {name}, applied only to linked indicator definitions. Assessment scope is unchanged.

english: Historical milestone cutoffs: {earlier} and {date}. Current definitions and corrected histories are used; assessment responses and action status are not historical snapshots.
afrikaans_before: Historiese mylpaalafsnydatums: {earlier} en {date}. Huidige definisies en gekorrigeerde geskiedenisse word gebruik; assesseringsantwoorde en aksiestatus is nie historiese momentopnames nie.
back_translation: Historical milestone cutoff dates: {earlier} and {date}. Current definitions and corrected histories are used; assessment answers and action status are not historical snapshots.

english: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: fictional programme evidence; not evidence of real results.
afrikaans_before: DEMONSTRASIEREKORDS: fiktiewe programbewyse; nie bewyse van werklike resultate nie.
back_translation: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: fictitious programme evidence; not evidence of real results.

english: Prepared {today}; milestone cutoff {date}. Assessments and actions are current snapshots.
afrikaans_before: Voorberei {today}; mylpaalafsnydatum {date}. Assesserings en aksies is huidige momentopnames.
back_translation: Prepared {today}; milestone cutoff date {date}. Assessments and actions are current snapshots.

english: Published, authorised evidence only. Small groups and private information remain withheld.
afrikaans_before: Slegs gepubliseerde, gemagtigde bewyse. Klein groepe en private inligting bly teruggehou.
back_translation: Only published, authorised evidence. Small groups and private information remain withheld.

english: Internal authorised analysis; identities and written feedback are omitted.
afrikaans_before: Interne gemagtigde ontleding; identiteite en geskrewe terugvoer is weggelaat.
back_translation: Internal authorised analysis; identities and written feedback are left out.

english: Project labels do not establish a common population across sources.
afrikaans_before: Projeketikette bewys nie 'n gemeenskaplike populasie oor bronne heen nie.
back_translation: Project labels do not prove a shared population across sources.

english: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: fictional evidence, not real results.
afrikaans_before: DEMONSTRASIEREKORDS: fiktiewe bewyse, nie werklike resultate nie.
back_translation: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: fictitious evidence, not real results.

english: Review unmatched follow-up and missing answers before generalising change to everyone enrolled. State who is absent and what the team will do to improve coverage.
afrikaans_before: Hersien ongepaarde opvolg en ontbrekende antwoorde voordat verandering veralgemeen word na almal wat ingeskryf is. Sê wie afwesig is en wat die span sal doen om dekking te verbeter.
back_translation: Review unmatched follow-up and missing answers before generalising change to everyone who enrolled. Say who is absent and what the team will do to improve coverage.

english: A baseline stage name does not establish that measurement preceded support. Check collection dates, retrospective answers, recall periods and seasonal context.
afrikaans_before: 'n Basislynstadiumnaam bewys nie dat meting voor ondersteuning plaasgevind het nie. Kontroleer insamelingsdatums, terugskouende antwoorde, herroepingstydperke en seisoenale konteks.
back_translation: A baseline stage name does not prove that measurement took place before support. Check collection dates, retrospective answers, recall periods and seasonal context.

english: Self-reported skills and ordinal scores describe respondents’ answers. They are separate from a demonstrated practical task, later adoption and household outcomes.
afrikaans_before: Selfgerapporteerde vaardighede en ordinale tellings beskryf respondente se antwoorde. Hulle is afsonderlik van 'n gedemonstreerde praktiese taak, latere aanvaarding en huishoudelike uitkomste.
back_translation: Self-reported skills and ordinal counts describe respondents' answers. They are separate from a demonstrated practical task, later adoption and household outcomes.
afrikaans_after: Selfgerapporteerde vaardighede en ordinale puntetellings beskryf respondente se antwoorde. Hulle is afsonderlik van 'n gedemonstreerde praktiese taak, latere aanvaarding en huishoudelike uitkomste.
note: "tellings" reads as counts; English is scores

english: Agree the next action, owner, review date and evidence of completion in the existing assessment or programme register. Review whether the change helped.
afrikaans_before: Kom die volgende aksie, eienaar, hersieningsdatum en bewys van voltooiing in die bestaande assesserings- of programregister ooreen. Hersien of die verandering gehelp het.
back_translation: Agree the next action, owner, review date and proof of completion in the existing assessment or programme register. Review whether the change helped.

english: Use the wider evidence crosswalk to agree additional measurement with the programme and donor. This report makes no causal, nutrition, profit or sustainability-score claim.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik die wyer bewyskruisverwysing om bykomende meting met die program en skenker ooreen te kom. Hierdie verslag maak geen aanspraak oor oorsaaklikheid, voeding, wins of volhoubaarheidspunte nie.
back_translation: Use the broader evidence cross-reference to agree additional measurement with the programme and donor. This report makes no claim about causality, nutrition, profit or sustainability scores.
afrikaans_after: Gebruik die wyer bewyskruisverwysing om bykomende meting met die program en skenker ooreen te kom. Hierdie verslag maak geen aanspraak oor oorsaaklikheid, voeding, wins of volhoubaarheidspuntetellings nie.
note: "punte" read as points; English is sustainability scores

english: Sources: authorised assessment summaries/analysis and programme milestones. Dates, units, baselines, targets and evidence references remain as recorded.
afrikaans_before: Bronne: gemagtigde assesseringsopsommings/-ontleding en programmylpale. Datums, eenhede, basislyne, teikens en bewysverwysings bly soos aangeteken.
back_translation: Sources: authorised assessment summaries/analysis and programme milestones. Dates, units, baselines, targets and evidence references remain as recorded.

english: Matched comparisons use the same project and instrument version, compatible stages, the latest consenting response per participant, and valid numeric answers. Not tried / not applicable answers are excluded from numeric comparisons.
afrikaans_before: Gepaarde vergelykings gebruik dieselfde projek- en instrumentweergawe, versoenbare stadiums, die jongste toestemmende antwoord per deelnemer en geldige numeriese antwoorde. Antwoorde soos nie probeer nie / nie van toepassing nie word van numeriese vergelykings uitgesluit.
back_translation: Matched comparisons use the same project and instrument version, compatible stages, the latest consenting answer per participant and valid numeric answers. Answers such as not tried / not applicable are excluded from numeric comparisons.

english: Before/after means use the matched set for that question. Unmatched valid answers are shown separately; no percentage change is invented from an ordinal confidence score or a zero baseline.
afrikaans_before: Gemiddeldes voor/na gebruik die gepaarde stel vir daardie vraag. Ongepaarde geldige antwoorde word afsonderlik getoon; geen persentasieverandering word uit 'n ordinale vertrouenstelling of 'n nul-basislyn versin nie.
back_translation: Before/after averages use the matched set for that question. Unmatched valid answers are shown separately; no percentage change is invented from an ordinal confidence rating or a zero baseline.
afrikaans_after: Gemiddeldes voor/na gebruik die gepaarde stel vir daardie vraag. Ongepaarde geldige antwoorde word afsonderlik getoon; geen persentasieverandering word uit 'n ordinale vertrouenspuntetelling of 'n nul-basislyn versin nie.
note: "vertrouenstelling" reads as a confidence count; English is a confidence score

english: Published comparisons also suppress small matched groups, small excluded groups and suppressed source distributions. A withheld result is not zero.
afrikaans_before: Gepubliseerde vergelykings onderdruk ook klein gepaarde groepe, klein uitgesluite groepe en onderdrukte brondistribusies. 'n Teruggehoue resultaat is nie nul nie.
back_translation: Published comparisons also suppress small matched groups, small excluded groups and suppressed source distributions. A withheld result is not zero.

english: Responses / eligible present register entries; repeats included
afrikaans_before: Antwoorde / in aanmerking kommende teenwoordige registerinskrywings; herhalings ingesluit
back_translation: Answers / eligible present register entries; repeats included

english: One row per saved session. Facilitator names are recorded text; they are not verified staff identities. Present / registered describes session places, not unique learners.
afrikaans_before: Een ry per gestoorde sessie. Fasiliteerdername is aangetekende teks; hulle is nie geverifieerde personeelidentiteite nie. Teenwoordig / geregistreer beskryf sessieplekke, nie unieke leerders nie.
back_translation: One row per saved session. Facilitator names are recorded text; they are not verified staff identities. Present / registered describe session places, not unique learners.

english: Counts are session responses to the existing feedback questions. The same learner can respond after several sessions. Written feedback is excluded from this default aggregate export. This is experience feedback, not a skills test.
afrikaans_before: Tellings is sessieantwoorde op die bestaande terugvoervrae. Dieselfde leerder kan ná verskeie sessies antwoord. Geskrewe terugvoer is van hierdie verstek-samevattingsuitvoer uitgesluit. Dit is ervaringsterugvoer, nie 'n vaardigheidstoets nie.
back_translation: Counts are session answers to the existing feedback questions. The same learner can answer after several sessions. Written feedback is excluded from this default summary output. This is experience feedback, not a skills test.

english: Signatures and certificates relate to attendance. They do not establish assessed competence or qualification. Photograph counts do not establish consent to share an image.
afrikaans_before: Handtekeninge en sertifikate hou verband met bywoning. Hulle bewys nie beoordeelde bevoegdheid of kwalifikasie nie. Fototellings bewys nie toestemming om 'n beeld te deel nie.
back_translation: Signatures and certificates relate to attendance. They do not prove assessed competence or qualification. Photo counts do not prove consent to share an image.

english: A link identifies where to review assessment evidence; it does not merge the assessment population with these session totals. Follow-up notes are as recorded and have no inferred owner or due date.
afrikaans_before: 'n Skakel dui aan waar assesseringsbewyse hersien kan word; dit voeg nie die assesseringspopulasie by hierdie sessietotale saam nie. Opvolgnotas is soos aangeteken en het geen afgeleide eienaar of sperdatum nie.
back_translation: A link indicates where assessment evidence can be reviewed; it does not add the assessment population to these session totals. Follow-up notes are as recorded and have no derived owner or closing date.

afrikaans_before: Gekoppelde assessering · titel nie beskikbaar nie

english: Saved session summaries. These are reports by the delivery team, not independent verification.
afrikaans_before: Gestoorde sessie-opsommings. Dit is verslae deur die leweringspan, nie onafhanklike verifikasie nie.
back_translation: Saved session summaries. These are reports by the delivery team, not independent verification.
note: "verhaal" for narrative; register

english: {sessions} saved sessions record {attendances} attendances across {registered} registered session places. A repeat attendance is another session place, not a new learner.
afrikaans_before: {sessions} gestoorde sessies teken {attendances} bywonings aan oor {registered} geregistreerde sessieplekke. 'n Herhaalde bywoning is nog 'n sessieplek, nie 'n nuwe leerder nie.
back_translation: {sessions} saved sessions record {attendances} attendances across {registered} registered session places. A repeat attendance is another session place, not a new learner.

english: {learners} distinct registered participant IDs are represented. {guests} guest attendances are excluded from that unique-learner count because their identity across sessions is not established.
afrikaans_before: {learners} afsonderlike geregistreerde deelnemer-ID's word verteenwoordig. {guests} gasbywonings is van daardie telling van unieke leerders uitgesluit omdat hul identiteit oor sessies heen nie vasgestel is nie.
back_translation: {learners} separate registered participant IDs are represented. {guests} guest attendances are excluded from that count of unique learners because their identity across sessions was not established.

english: {completed} session feedback responses are available for {assigned} eligible present register entries. The report does not turn satisfaction or a certificate of attendance into demonstrated competence.
afrikaans_before: {completed} sessieterugvoerantwoorde is beskikbaar vir {assigned} in aanmerking kommende teenwoordige registerinskrywings. Die verslag maak nie van tevredenheid of 'n bywoningsertifikaat gedemonstreerde bevoegdheid nie.
back_translation: {completed} session feedback answers are available for {assigned} eligible present register entries. The report does not turn satisfaction or an attendance certificate into demonstrated competence.

english: Prepared {today} from saved records. Unsaved session edits are excluded.
afrikaans_before: Voorberei {today} uit gestoorde rekords. Ongestoorde sessiewysigings is uitgesluit.
back_translation: Prepared {today} from saved records. Unsaved session changes are excluded.

english: Session records are restricted to the selected record-owning account. A typed facilitator name is not used to infer ownership.
afrikaans_before: Sessierekords is beperk tot die gekose rekordhoudende rekening. 'n Getikte fasiliteerdernaam word nie gebruik om eienaarskap af te lei nie.
back_translation: Session records are limited to the chosen record-keeping account. A typed facilitator name is not used to infer ownership.

english: All record-owning accounts represented in the authorised session source are included.
afrikaans_before: Alle rekordhoudende rekeninge wat in die gemagtigde sessiebron verteenwoordig word, is ingesluit.
back_translation: All record-keeping accounts represented in the authorised session source are included.

english: This is an internal facilitator delivery report. Named registers, signatures, contact details and written participant feedback are excluded from this aggregate export.
afrikaans_before: Dit is 'n interne fasiliteerder-leweringsverslag. Registers met name, handtekeninge, kontakbesonderhede en geskrewe deelnemerterugvoer is van hierdie samevattingsuitvoer uitgesluit.
back_translation: This is an internal facilitator delivery report. Registers with names, signatures, contact details and written participant feedback are excluded from this summary output.

english: Registration and attendance are session measures. Completion of a multi-session course needs its own agreed requirements and evidence.
afrikaans_before: Registrasie en bywoning is sessiemaatstawwe. Voltooiing van 'n kursus met verskeie sessies het sy eie ooreengekome vereistes en bewyse nodig.
back_translation: Registration and attendance are session measures. Completion of a course with several sessions needs its own agreed requirements and evidence.

english: Review the existing before/after assessments using matched consenting participants. Separate reported confidence from observed practical performance.
afrikaans_before: Hersien die bestaande assesserings voor/na met gepaarde deelnemers wat toestemming gegee het. Skei gerapporteerde selfvertroue van waargenome praktiese prestasie.
back_translation: Review the existing before/after assessments with matched participants who gave consent. Separate reported self-confidence from observed practical performance.

english: Use mentor skill observations and later garden checks to establish application. Intending to try a practice after training does not establish that it was adopted.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik mentor-vaardigheidswaarnemings en latere tuinkontroles om toepassing vas te stel. Die voorneme om 'n praktyk ná opleiding te probeer, bewys nie dat dit aanvaar is nie.
back_translation: Use mentor skills observations and later garden checks to establish application. The intention to try a practice after training does not prove that it was adopted.

english: Agree an owner, review date and evidence of completion for follow-up actions in the programme action or visit register.
afrikaans_before: Kom 'n eienaar, hersieningsdatum en bewys van voltooiing vir opvolgaksies in die programaksie- of besoekregister ooreen.
back_translation: Agree an owner, review date and proof of completion for follow-up actions in the programme action or visit register.

english: Use feedback about explanation, practice and language to decide what to change in the next session. Record whether that change helped.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik terugvoer oor verduideliking, oefening en taal om te besluit wat in die volgende sessie verander moet word. Teken aan of die verandering gehelp het.
back_translation: Use feedback about explanation, practice and language to decide what to change in the next session. Record whether the change helped.

english: Source: saved training records available to the current account. Session dates set the reporting period. Published and internal records are not interchangeable access scopes.
afrikaans_before: Bron: gestoorde opleidingsrekords wat vir die huidige rekening beskikbaar is. Sessiedatums bepaal die verslagtydperk. Gepubliseerde en interne rekords is nie uitruilbare toegangsomvange nie.
back_translation: Source: saved training records available for the current account. Session dates determine the report period. Published and internal records are not interchangeable access scopes.

english: Registered participant IDs are deduplicated across selected sessions. Guest attendances are reported separately; a guest name or code does not prove a unique person across sessions.
afrikaans_before: Geregistreerde deelnemer-ID's word oor die gekose sessies heen ontdubbel. Gasbywonings word afsonderlik gerapporteer; 'n gasnaam of -kode bewys nie 'n unieke persoon oor sessies heen nie.
back_translation: Registered participant IDs are de-duplicated across the chosen sessions. Guest attendances are reported separately; a guest name or code does not prove a unique person across sessions.

english: Feedback uses the existing instrument and consenting responses from present participants. Several responses from one learner across sessions remain several session responses.
afrikaans_before: Terugvoer gebruik die bestaande instrument en antwoorde met toestemming van teenwoordige deelnemers. Verskeie antwoorde van een leerder oor sessies heen bly verskeie sessieantwoorde.
back_translation: Feedback uses the existing instrument and answers with consent from present participants. Several answers from one learner across sessions remain several session answers.

english: Attendance, course progress, self-reported learning, observed competence and sustained application are distinct evidence. This report makes no attribution or household-impact claim.
afrikaans_before: Bywoning, kursusvordering, selfgerapporteerde leer, waargenome bevoegdheid en volgehoue toepassing is afsonderlike bewyse. Hierdie verslag maak geen aanspraak op oorsaaklike toeskrywing of huishoudelike impak nie.
back_translation: Attendance, course progress, self-reported learning, observed competence and sustained application are separate evidence. This report makes no claim of causal attribution or household impact.

Repeated attendances and guest entries are not new identified learners. Recorded zeros do not establish no delivery. This is not a competence or impact comparison.
afrikaans_before: Vroeër {earlierFrom} tot {earlierTo}; gekies {from} tot {to}. Gelyke getalle kalenderdae, met gestoorde rekords en dieselfde projek-/rekordeienaarfilters. Dit is nie 'n bevoegdheids- of impakvergelyking nie.
back_translation: Earlier {earlierFrom} to {earlierTo}; chosen {from} to {to}. Equal numbers of calendar days, with saved records and the same project/record-owner filters. Period populations may differ. Repeat attendances and guest entries are not new identified learners. Recorded zeros do not prove that there was no delivery. back_translation: Actions from visits in this choice, at their latest recorded status on {today}, earliest closing dates first. Earlier visits outside the filter may have other open actions.

back_translation: The latest completion dates may fall after the chosen visit period. This is a review of current status, not a historical snapshot of actions.
